name: NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper (96GB HBM3)
memory_bandwidth_basis: 4 TB/s HBM3 figure as used in NVIDIA GH200 materials; TRT-LLM page lists 'GH200 96GB HBM3 (480GB LPDDR5X)'. Recorded as nominal HBM bandwidth pending datasheet transcription.
notes: Grace+Hopper superchip: 96 GB HBM3 on the GPU plus 480 GB LPDDR5X on the Grace CPU, coherent over NVLink-C2C (900 GB/s). The big coherent pool is the LLM-relevant property. TRT-LLM vendor throughput numbers recorded in data/benchmarks/trtllm-gh200-*.
